opinions.text:
The order entered February 12 [post, p. 669] denying petition for writ of certiorari in this case is revoked. The petition for writ of cer*656tiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit is granted, limited to the question presented upon the petition for rehearing.
